checks: Real SQL: anonymous and non-admin see public only; local admin sees both
Anonymous public image returns exact bytes with no-store, no redirect or signed URL
Private image: owner only; central ID, visitor and other-project owner rejected
Private, absent, path substitution and traversal have identical external error
Expired and revoked administrator credentials cannot read private image
Unattached upload: owner preview only; direct Storage paths and listing unavailable
Visibility changes stop new anonymous reads; owner retains access
Visibility change during Storage download prevents response bytes
Auth-provider rejection during Storage download prevents private response bytes (mock revocation)
Deleted or detached file cannot be fetched, even when its bytes remain stored
Rejected signed-URL alternative: valid bearer outlives policy change; expiry cannot recall cached bytes
scope: Existing personal migrations + authenticateOwner, disposable candidate photo RLS and real loopback HTTP bytes. Auth/Storage/clock are doubles. No production implementation or hosted Storage/CDN/browser validation.
decision: Private bucket; per-request authenticated binary proxy, no signed/public Storage URLs to browsers.
